nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

widgets_values:
## Model Links
[🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

**loras**

- 4 steps: [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: READ ME · Character Swap v1 setup and tips
widgets_values:
# Akatz Labs · Character Swap LoRA v1

## 1. Download the character LoRA
[Model card](https://huggingface.co/akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA) · [Download the 1000-step weights](https://huggingface.co/akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA/resolve/main/h3_character_swap_pro4500_1000.safetensors)

Put `h3_character_swap_pro4500_1000.safetensors` in **ComfyUI/models/loras/** and refresh the model list (or restart ComfyUI). Select it in **Load LoRA** node, with **strength 1.0**. Set strength to 0 for a base-model comparison. No trigger word is needed.

## 2. Supply your inputs
- Upload a replacement image or character sheet into **<Picture 1>**.
- Upload a short **24 fps** source clip into **<Video 1>**. Start with a continuous shot around 5 seconds.
- Edit the prompt to identify exactly who to replace. The reference supplies identity, outfit and art style; the video supplies performance and scene.
- The loader does **not** resample frame rate. Convert non-24-fps clips beforehand while preserving playback speed.

## 3. Default settings
**Ref2VA INT8 · character LoRA 1.0 · 20 steps · res_multistep / simple · Turbo OFF.** All execution nodes are built into ComfyUI; no custom-node pack is required. Validated against ComfyUI 0.37.0.

The optional Turbo branch is preserved from the official template. Its loader is **bypassed** so its weights are not required. To enable Turbo: download its listed weights, select its loader and press **Ctrl+B** to un-bypass it, then turn **Enable optional Turbo** on. This is a separate accelerator; the character LoRA remains active with either branch.

Resolution starts at **0.4 MP / 864 × 480**. Set **0.98 MP / 1344 × 768** for 768p; match the source aspect ratio. Higher resolution, longer clips and larger references require more memory. This is not a blanket 24 GB fit guarantee.

Set duration to match your clip. H3 uses **24 fps** and **17n+5 frames**: 5 seconds rounds up to **124 frames / 5.167 seconds**. For aligned comparisons, prepare a matching frame count or trim the final output.

## 4. Audio and limitations
Source audio is disconnected by default so silent clips work. If your source has sound, optionally connect **Get Video Components → audio** to **ref_video_audios.ref_video_audio_0**. H3 still generates audio; exact preservation requires muxing the original soundtrack afterward.

V1 can drift in timing, facial expressions and hard cuts, especially on long clips. Source-video conditioning is not a pixel-preserving mask. Keep prompts clear; additional wording does not guarantee stronger adherence.

A compatible Ref2VA hybrid can be selected in the model loader, but it is not required or bundled. Plain FL2VA/T2V weights are not a drop-in replacement for this reference workflow.

## Upstream
Based on [ComfyUI's official H3 Ref2VA template](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/video_minimax_h3_r2v.json). Its original notes are retained. **Save/export this workflow after selecting your own inputs.**
